CP_BASEURL.description: REQUIRED — the public URL of the Castopod service, ending with a trailing slash. Use Railway's public domain.

CP_ANALYTICS_SALT.description: REQUIRED — a 64-character random string used for analytics hashing. Auto-generated.

RAILWAY_RUN_UID.description: User ID to run as. Must be 0 (root) because the Railway volume at /app/public/media mounts root-owned. The image's s6 services inherit the container user, and the default image user (www-data uid 33) cannot write to a root-owned volume → bootstrap fails.

CP_DATABASE_HOSTNAME.description: Database host (wired from the MariaDB companion service)

CP_DATABASE_NAME.description: Database name (wired from the MariaDB companion service)

CP_DATABASE_USERNAME.description: Database user (wired from the MariaDB companion service)

CP_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Database password (wired from the MariaDB companion service)

CP_MEDIA_BASEURL.description: Optional — separate public domain for media delivery. Leave empty to use CP_BASEURL.

CP_EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional — From address for outgoing mail
